reviews.title: TooEasy to erase.
reviews.text: It is ridiculously easy to erase the pages.  That should be an easy fix

reviews.title: Bigger
reviews.text: Could use a few more lines to type notes. Have to be careful or can it a button on side of phone and erase list. I screenshot it when done w list and go shopping

reviews.title: Post it notes
reviews.text: I wish it was not several pages. It should be that you can post multiple separate pages instead of flipping pages

reviews.title: Bad App
reviews.text:
This app sucks
Paper color is ugly
Can’t change font
Or font size
Not enough room for notes
When minimized it doesn’t show you the list only Part of it.
Can’t move text left right center
Update button doesn’t do anything
Can’t change anything, you get what you get.
Dumping this app.
